name: 曜日と開閉時刻を個別に編集する行
prompt: Create ONLY the compact Japanese opening-hours row shown in the Japanese mock. One horizontal row, pure white #FFFFFF, four separate text runs left to right exact '火曜日', '6:00', '〜', '22:00'. Preserve the original Tuesday 6AM–10PM meaning exactly. Weekday at left, time cluster at right, consistent baseline. Meiryo Regular14/24 role for all four text runs, zero tracking; fine regular strokes, never bold or semibold, dark #1D1D1D. Match mock's quiet simple four-column spacing with a larger flexible gap after weekday and narrow balanced gaps around wave dash. Minimal vertical padding, wide low-height strip, no heading, border, card, icons, green accents, label, extra rows or device chrome. All glyphs sharp and complete. This is a static raster candidate for the single row; no interactive editor UI to invent.
reviewNotes: Weekday, opening/closing values and four-run order correct. Japanese weekday visibly heavier than mock Regular; excessive vertical whitespace. Target fine Regular strokes and minimal vertical framing, preserve single-row content.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
